categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes address advertisement logic in src/net.cpp for Tor and I2P peer connections.
categories.rationale: Prevents adversarial privacy network peers from injecting arbitrary local addresses that can correlate a node's clearnet and Tor/I2P identities. Although exploiting the fingerprint requires non-default listening ports and outbound connections to an attacker, fixing identity leaks across privacy networks represents substantial, durable protection for node operators.
